convert.title: Convert
convert.subtitle: Build a device file from an image, via a DeviceLink toward the loaded paper. Separate from printing — the output is saved to disk.
convert.no_source_profile: This image carries no embedded ICC profile — it cannot be converted (no source space to read). Re-export it with an embedded profile.
convert.gamut_help: The collink gamut-mapping intent used to fit the image into the paper's gamut. These are collink's own gamut intents (not a profile's ICC rendering intent). Each shows its command and its cost — none is “best”. Relative is the current default; the last entry is a freeglaz custom (it does not use -G).
convert.gamut_desc_relative: Current behaviour. Slightly lightens saturated colours; separates the deepest shadows the least.
convert.gamut_desc_luminance_matched: Matches the white→black luminance axis: preserves separation in the deepest shadows. Lightens saturated colours.
convert.gamut_desc_perceptual: 3-D perceptual compression. Lightens saturated colours and desaturates them.
convert.gamut_desc_luminance_preserving: 3-D perceptual compression that favours lightness. Preserves deep-shadow separation; lightens saturated colours.
convert.gamut_desc_luminance_priority: Custom abstract: chroma compression at constant luminance. Preserves the lightness of saturated colours; desaturates them in exchange. Separates the deepest shadows less.
convert.gamut_desc_relative_bpc: Relative colorimetric with black point compensation: lifts the whole dark range to avoid clipping below the paper's printable black. In exchange it lightens — “washes” — the blacks. Useful mainly if the file holds detail below the printable black; no benefit if its blacks already sit above it.
convert.tau_help: Trade-off cursor for “Saturated-colour lightness”. Lower τ protects luminance more and sacrifices more chroma; higher τ keeps more chroma at the cost of some luminance recoupling. τ = 1 is the reference, not an optimum.
convert.quality_help: Resolution of the DeviceLink's 3-D conversion grid (collink -q). Higher = finer grid → smoother gradients and fewer interpolation artefacts, but a slower build and a larger link. It does NOT change the number of inks or the profile — only how finely the source→paper mapping is sampled. High is a good default for photos; Ultra only for critical work.
convert.ge_help: Which resident characterization of the loaded paper is used as the destination: GE ON (gloss enhancer applied) or GE OFF. The two do not have the same colour — pick the one matching how you will actually print.
convert.image_aware_help: Independent of the intent. Off: map the full source-profile gamut (default). On: map only the gamut the image actually occupies (extracted with tiffgamut) — compresses just what really falls out of the paper's gamut and leaves already-printable colours alone. Useful when the perceptual intent otherwise shifts the whole image.
convert.viewcond_desc_default: collink defaults: average surround, adaptation 50 cd/m², background 20%, adapted white = media white. Not specific to print viewing.
convert.viewcond_desc_pm: Print evaluation with partial Mid-tone adaptation. mtaf 0.7, Wxyz2 D50. Intended for papers containing FWA/OBE brighteners viewed in an environment with a noticeably warmer white point than the paper: the white point stays that of the paper, but mid-tones are partially adapted to the warmer white point, possibly reducing visual discrepancy. Note (Gill): this situation doesn't often arise in real-world viewing of such media; and it is a trap to evaluate FWA/OBE-rich paper under standard proofing conditions, whose spectrally flat grey surround unnaturally emphasizes the white-point difference.
convert.viewcond_note: A refinement, not a strong control: expect a subtle-to-marginal effect (a few levels at most), mostly on the perceptual intents with saturated content — near-zero with relative colorimetric, and it can be nil on some profiles.
convert.dest_no_paper: No paper loaded — load a paper in the Z9 to resolve the destination profile.
convert.run_and_print_help: Converts, then loads the device file into the Print tab (raw device passthrough — the values reach the inks untouched). You set the geometry and confirm there; nothing prints automatically.
convert.offline_hint: Z9 unreachable — the destination profile cannot be resolved while offline.
convert.error_unsupported_lut: Profile not supported by the Convert module. This profile uses ICC mAB/mBA tables, which the Argyll conversion engine currently used by freeglaz does not support. Convert accepts profiles using mft1/mft2 tables.

profils.validate_caveat: INDEPENDENT validation: the profile is tested on a chart ≠ its creation set (true predictive accuracy, not optimistic self-coherence). The result reflects the CURRENT physical state (paper/GE/calibration) — so it also detects DRIFT since the profile was built.
profils.validate_indep_ok: Independence verified: {{pct}} % overlap with the creation chart (low).
profils.validate_indep_bad: ⚠ High overlap with creation ({{pct}} %) — validation drifts toward self-coherence. Regenerate the chart (more distinct distribution).
profils.validate_indep_unknown: Profile without embedded creation measurements — overlap not verifiable (independence assumed from the -q distribution).
profils.check_caveat: Self-coherence: checks the profile against ITS OWN creation patches (best case, optimistic). Mainly catches measurement anomalies (misreads), NOT real predictive quality — that is measured by an independent validation (chart ≠ creation). A good score here ≠ excellent profile.
profils.check_iso_ref: Scale reference (context, not a target): ISO 12647-7/8 (CMYK offset proofing) places “good” around avg ΔE < 3 / max < 6. For fine-art RGB photo, the stricter house grid above prevails.
profils.check_no_measurements: This profile does not carry its creation measurements (no embedded ti3) — self-coherence cannot be computed. Use an independent validation (chart ≠ creation) to assess its accuracy.

view3d.entry_eff_perceptual_description: Volume of the Lab space effectively renderable by the device using the perceptual intent. Perceptual compresses out-of-gamut colors to preserve relationships between colors — useful for natural images. Computed by projecting the device's RGB cube surface via the A2B0 LUT.
view3d.entry_eff_relative_description: Volume of the Lab space effectively renderable under relative colorimetric intent. This intent clips out-of-gamut colors to the nearest boundary without touching in-gamut colors — useful for faithful reproduction and soft-proofing. Computed by projecting the device's RGB cube surface via the A2B1 LUT.
view3d.entry_eff_saturation_description: Volume of the Lab space effectively renderable under saturation intent. This intent favors perceived saturation over colorimetric accuracy — useful for graphics and presentations. Computed by projecting the device's RGB cube surface via the A2B2 LUT.
view3d.entry_A2B0_description: Conversion table from the device (RGB or CMYK) to the connection space (Lab or XYZ), under perceptual intent. Used by the system when an image tagged with this profile is read to produce absolute colorimetric coordinates.
view3d.entry_A2B1_description: Conversion table from the device to the connection space, under relative colorimetric intent. 1:1 conversion when possible, clipping of out-of-gamut colors to the nearest boundary.
view3d.entry_A2B2_description: Conversion table from the device to the connection space, under saturation intent. Preserves perceived saturation more than colorimetric accuracy.
view3d.entry_B2A0_description: Conversion table from the connection space to the device, under perceptual intent. Used when printing: compresses the source gamut into the device gamut while preserving relationships between colors.
view3d.entry_B2A1_description: Conversion table from the connection space to the device, under relative colorimetric intent. In-gamut colors preserved exactly, out-of-gamut colors clipped to the boundary.
view3d.entry_B2A2_description: Conversion table from the connection space to the device, under saturation intent. Maximizes rendered saturation, typical intent for graphics.
view3d.entry_gamt_description: Gamut indicator provided by the profiler: for each PCS coordinate, a value indicating whether it is renderable by the device (0) or out of gamut (value increasing with distance). The 3D visualization shows the transition boundary between the two. Represents the profiler's view, to be compared with the effective gamut computed on the device surface.
view3d.interactions_hint: Drag: rotate · Scroll: zoom · Right-click + drag (or Ctrl + drag on Mac): pan · Double-click: reset (twice quickly → fallback view)

slice2d.area_uncomputable_hint: Contour cannot be chained into a single closed loop (self-intersection at a fold, or pathological mesh at this L). Indicates a non-physical profile at this level, not a computation error.

mapping.empty_slice: No slice at L*={{L}} (out of gamut)
mapping.interactions_hint: Comparison of the same profile's intents on the same a*b* slice. At a given L, perceptual compresses out-of-gamut colors (tighter contour), relative clips them to the boundary (contour closer to the surface). At extreme L (shadows/highlights), perceptual and relative can diverge — this is faithful to the profile, not a computation error.

roll.session_scans_other: {{count}} scans already taken on this chart — “Scan” adds one more (repeatability / average).
roll.less_than_two_scans: Fewer than 2 stable scans: nothing to compare.

moved_modal.title: Check the chart to scan
moved_modal.roll: Roll: rewind the chart to the maximum at the panel (hold the button until it stops automatically, without disengaging it).
moved_modal.sheet: Sheet: reload the dry chart in the manual feed.

blocked_modal.title: A scan is already open on another chart
blocked_modal.body_suffix: has an open scan. Close it to scan this one.
blocked_modal.finish_and_scan: Close it and scan this one

base.average_recommended_mid: (recommended): averages the {{n}} KEPT scans → cuts measurement noise below the single-scan floor (~0.10 ΔE).
base.single_kept: 1 scan kept. To average, keep ≥2 scans (or run a 2nd scan).
base.drying_note: Drying: measurements drift while the ink dries (RC/gloss ~30 min, matte/canvas longer; saturated/dark slower). Scan again when ready.

confirm.chart_body: Permanently deletes the chart image, the measurements (ti3) and the metadata. An already-built ICC profile (separate file) is not affected. Irreversible.
confirm.lighten_body: Deletes the large TIFF chart image but KEEPS the measurements (re-profiling/re-validating stays possible). The chart will no longer be reprintable.
confirm.scan_body: Permanently deletes this scan (ti3 + cgats) — irreversible (unlike “exclude”, which keeps it). A profile built from this set will then note an earlier provenance (rebuild to update it).

mesures.title: Measurements
mesures.intro: Chart library — all papers, all stages. Viewing (scans, repeatability, profile) is always available.
mesures.sources_hint: Same paper and GE. Aggregates more measurements for a denser profile (the current chart is always included).
mesures.open_in_scan_flow_hint: Scanning a chart (hardware) happens in the scan flow, which requires the paper loaded. Building/rebuilding the profile happens here, in software.
mesures.profile_conflict_body: A profile “{{name}}” already exists in this paper's library. “Replace” puts the new profile in its place; the old file is kept, with its tags and notes, in the paper's backups (.replaced folder, not listed). Tags and notes are not carried over to the new profile. “Keep both” adds the new profile under another name and leaves the old one untouched.
mesures.build_done_installable: Ready to install on the printer.
mesures.build_done_not_ranged: Profile built, but not filed (unknown printer) — not installable.
mesures.profile_conflict_body_build: A profile “{{name}}” already exists in this paper's library. “Replace” puts the new profile in its place; the old file is kept, with its tags and notes, in the paper's backups (.replaced folder, not listed). Tags and notes are not carried over to the new profile. “Keep both” adds the new profile under another name and leaves the old one untouched. Every version built from this chart stays in its history.

chart_create.title: Create a profiling chart
chart_create.f_over: -f {{n}} exceeds the max ({{max}}) for this format
chart_create.tag_note: The chart will be tagged with the slot's RESIDENT profile, read live.
chart_create.print_confirm: Load {{paper}} ({{format}}), GE={{ge}}. The Z9 prints on receipt. Print?
chart_create.printed_next: Let it dry. Sheet: reload it dry via manual feed. Roll: rewind to the MAX at the panel (until the auto-stop, without disengaging). Scanning happens from the library.
chart_create.argyll_mode_print_desc: Compose then print a free chart on this paper. Scanning happens later, offline.
chart_create.argyll_mode_scan_desc: Pick a chart printed on this paper, scan it and build the profile.
chart_create.argyll_offline_note: Offline measurement: print → dry → reload the sheet → scan. No automatic mode.
chart_create.start_refine_desc: Pre-conditions the chart with the resident profile on this slot.
chart_create.start_custom_desc: Use a custom profile as pre-conditioning.
chart_create.no_printed_charts: No printed chart for this paper.
chart_create.no_printed_charts_hint: Print a chart on {{paper}} first, then come back to scan it.
chart_create.scan_done_next: Measurement saved. Next step: build the ICC profile.
chart_create.validate_targen_hint: INDEPENDENT chart: quasi-random distribution (-q) ≠ the creation set, moderate count (verify, don't build). Non-overlap with the creation chart is verified a posteriori, in the validation report (after scanning).
chart_create.lighten_confirm: Removes the large chart raster (TIFF, ~99 % of the size) and KEEPS the measurements (ti3) + metadata. Chart {{id}} stays usable to re-profile / re-validate, but can no longer be reprinted.
chart_create.delete_confirm: Deletes EVERYTHING (raster + ti3 measurements + metadata) of {{id}} and frees all disk. The measurements will be LOST. Any ICC profile built from this chart is a separate file and is not affected.
chart_create.no_scanned_validation: No scanned validation chart for this paper.
chart_create.pick_scanned_chart: Resume an already-scanned validation chart (no reprint), or compose a new one:
chart_create.validate_ready_hint: The independent chart is measured. “Validate” compares the profile's PREDICTION to the measurements (true accuracy), without rewriting the profile.
chart_create.profile_done_next: Profile built. You can install it on the slot from the Papers page.
chart_create.preview_hint: Check the chart above before printing. Cancelling does not save it to the library.
chart_create.profile_done_local: Profile built (in the chart folder). Filing by paper unavailable (printer not identified at creation).

measure_qc.open_measures: See the measurements and the check
measure_qc.export_title: Exports all measurements (not only the filter), with the check columns when available.

summary.limited_one: No inconsistency detected by this check, with one limit: {{count}} measurement not assessable.
summary.limited_other: No inconsistency detected by this check, with limits: {{count}} measurements not assessable.
summary.limited_no_na: No inconsistency detected by this check, with limits (see below).
summary.clean: No inconsistency detected by this check.
summary.counts: {{n}} patches examined · {{strong}} strongly suspect · {{to_check}} to check · {{na}} not assessable
summary.disclaimer: Advisory check: each measurement is compared with the other colours of the same chart. It removes nothing, does not validate the measurements and does not guarantee the profile. A smooth drift of a whole region can escape it.

state.invalid: Check impossible: measurements not analysable ({{reason}}). This is not a "no anomaly" result.
state.unavailable: Quality check unavailable for this scan.
state.error: Technical error in the quality check. This is not a "no anomaly" result.
state.measurements_shown: The readable measurements are still shown below, without the consistency check.

status_title.strong: Large and reliable deviation from the other colours of the chart, or a failed physical check. Worth examining: it does not prove the measurement is wrong.
status_title.to_check: Moderate deviation from the other colours of the chart: worth a look, no conclusion.
status_title.not_assessable: The check cannot judge this measurement (insufficient or inconsistent neighbourhood). This is a limit of the check: neither a validation nor an error.
status_title.coherent: Consistent with the other colours of the chart according to this check (not a validation).

reason.PHYS_WHITE_SUSPECT: Paper white reading suspect: {{n_lighter}} patches lighter than it
reason.DUP_DISCORDANT: Discordant repeated readings: {{dist_to_median}} ΔE00 from the median of the {{n}} readings of this patch
reason.DUP_PAIR_DIVERGENT: The 2 readings of this patch differ by {{disagreement}} ΔE00
reason.DUP_TWIN_DIVERGES: Its duplicate deviates from the neighbours; this reading is consistent
reason.DUP_CONFIRMED: Confirmed by {{n}} agreeing readings of this patch
reason.MODEL_RESIDUAL: Inconsistent with the neighbouring patches: deviation {{residual}} ΔE00 (score {{score}})
reason.MODEL_EXTRAPOLATION: Unreliable prediction: extrapolation (edge or corner of the cube)
reason.MODEL_INCOHERENT_NEIGHBORHOOD: Unreliable prediction: neighbours inconsistent with each other or a very curved response
reason.HIGH_DEVIATION_UNRELIABLE_PREDICTION: Large deviation ({{residual}} ΔE00) but unreliable prediction: re-measure rather than conclude
reason.MONOTONIC_INVERSION: Lightness inversion: darker than patches carrying more ink ({{n_inversions}})

finding.SET_INCOHERENT: Globally inconsistent set: {{pct}} % of the patches have an inconsistent neighbourhood. Check the chart (offset, wrong file) before examining patches one by one.
finding.ZONE_INCOHERENT: Inconsistent zone: {{n}} patches around RGB ({{rgb}}). Re-measuring the zone is safer than judging each patch.
finding.SET_INCOHERENT_LOW_DENSITY: Neighbourhoods often inconsistent ({{pct}} % of the patches) on a sparse chart: this may come from the low density rather than from a mis-attributed chart. The check is not very conclusive on this chart.
finding.LOW_DENSITY: Sparse chart ({{n}} patches): the sensitivity of the check is reduced.

warning.LAB_COLUMNS_INCONSISTENT_WITH_XYZ: The file's Lab columns do not match its XYZ: the check uses the XYZ (what colprof reads).
warning.NO_XYZ_LAB_COLUMNS_USED: No XYZ in the file: the check uses the Lab columns.
warning.XYZ_SCALE_0_1_RESCALED: XYZ given on the 0–1 scale: rescaled to 0–100 for the check.
warning.NUMBER_OF_SETS_MISMATCH: The patch count declared in the file does not match the rows present.
warning.MERGED_FILE_ANALYSED: A file merging several sources was analysed: duplicates come from other scans.
warning.IDENTICAL_DUPLICATE_ROWS: Strictly identical measurement rows: not counted as independent readings.

table.swatch_title: Approximate on-screen preview (sRGB): measured | predicted. Not faithful outside the sRGB gamut; the numbers are the reference.
table.device_swatch_title: RGB value sent to the printer (not the measured colour)
table.de00_title: ΔE00 between the measurement and the prediction made from the other patches
table.reliability_title: Reliability of the prediction (not of the measurement)

filter.flagged_title: Strongly suspect, to check AND not assessable
filter.excluded_title: Readings excluded from the next profile by your decision

badge.title: Measurement consistency check of this scan (advisory). Click for details.

impact.duplicate: Another compatible reading of this colour remains ({{n}}): simple exclusion.
impact.interior: Last reading of this interior patch: it will be interpolated from its neighbours.
impact.face: Last reading of this face patch: it will be interpolated from its neighbours.
impact.edge: Last reading of this edge patch: the profile will be less constrained along this edge.
impact.corner: Last reading of a cube corner: the profile will be much less constrained in this region.
impact.refused_white: This is the last reading of white: excluding it would make the profile impossible to build.
impact.refused_black: This is the last reading of black: excluding it would distort the profile's black point.

level_explain.ok: No patch is left without a measurement.
level_explain.info: Information: the profile will estimate this colour from the neighbouring measurements.
level_explain.strong_warning: Strong warning: a new measurement is preferable if the patch is doubtful.

exclusion.base_not_used: scan not used in this mode
exclusion.bases_differ: The consequences differ depending on the build mode chosen.
exclusion.refused_advice: Measure the chart again, or add a scan containing a valid reading of this patch.
exclusion.reason_informative: The reason is kept for information; it does not influence the profile build.
exclusion.exclude_title: Exclude this reading from the next profile (reversible)
exclusion.reinclude_title: Re-include this reading in the next profile

use.excluded_title: Excluded from the next profile by your decision (reversible)

table.use_title: Included in or excluded from the next profile — independent of the QC check
table.risk_title: Consequence announced if this reading were excluded (confirmed at the time of the action)

risk_title.refused: Last white or black: exclusion refused

exclusion.scan_excluded_hint: This scan is excluded: readings can only be excluded in an included scan.

error.refused: Exclusion refused by the structural-point check.
error.scan_excluded: This scan is excluded: include it again to manage its readings.
error.not_found: Reading or scan not found: the data may have changed. The view was refreshed.
error.unreadable: Unreadable measurements: this exclusion cannot be evaluated.
error.network: The local server does not answer: nothing was saved.

build_preview.title: Build preview
build_preview.newly_applied_one: The current build uses the former rule ("last scan" base without exclusions): {{count}} recorded exclusion is not applied in it; this build will apply it. An effect of the rule, not a new finding of the check.
build_preview.newly_applied_other: The current build uses the former rule ("last scan" base without exclusions): {{count}} recorded exclusions are not applied in it; this build will apply them. An effect of the rule, not a new finding of the check.
build_preview.strong_included_one: {{count}} strongly suspect measurement stays included: you may review it before building.
build_preview.strong_included_other: {{count}} strongly suspect measurements stay included: you may review them before building.

guard.QC_ZONE_INCOHERENT: zone flagged inconsistent by the check
guard.QC_SET_INCOHERENT_ISOLATED_EXCLUSIONS: globally inconsistent set: isolated exclusions discouraged

build_preview.recommend: Measuring the chart again is recommended.

refusal.WHITE_LAST_READING: Build impossible: white has no reading left in the scans used. Re-include it, change the base or measure again.
refusal.BLACK_LAST_READING: Build impossible: black has no reading left in the scans used. Re-include it, change the base or measure again.

build_preview.differs_current: The inputs differ from those of the current profile: the build will produce a different profile.
build_preview.same_as_current: Same inputs as the current profile.
build_preview.confirm_title: Build the profile with these choices?
build_preview.confirm_note: The current profile and every previous version are kept. Exclusions remain reversible.
build_preview.inputs_changed: The measurements or the choices changed since the preview: the preview was recomputed, check it and confirm again.
build_preview.coverage_refused: The build was refused: a structural point has no measurement left. The preview was recomputed.
build_preview.selection_differs: Your current choices also differ from those of the current build.
build_preview.newly_applied_neutral_one: {{count}} recorded exclusion will be applied. The current profile has no reliable manifest: whether it took it into account cannot be known.
build_preview.newly_applied_neutral_other: {{count}} recorded exclusions will be applied. The current profile has no reliable manifest: whether it took them into account cannot be known.

profile_history.publication: Publication state: {{state}} (repaired at the next build).
profile_history.provenance_unknown: Earlier profile — unknown provenance (built before version tracking).
profile_history.provenance_partial: Earlier profile — partial provenance (original description kept).
profile_history.summary: Base: {{base}} · {{scans}} scan(s) · {{extra}} added chart(s) · {{profiles}} source profile(s) · {{excluded}} excluded reading(s) · {{holes}} patch(es) without measurement
profile_history.kept_note: Every version is kept; nothing is deleted automatically.

state.up_to_date_title: The same request, made now, would use exactly the same inputs.
state.stale_title: The measurements, exclusions or sources changed since the build: the profile is not defective, but a rebuild would give a different profile.
state.missing_input_title: A scan, chart or source profile used no longer exists.
state.unknown_title: Cannot be determined with certainty (profile without a reliable manifest).

toolchain.changed_title: The colprof version differs from the one used to build the profile.
toolchain.unknown_title: The colprof version is unknown on one side or the other.

profile_compare.title: Compare two versions of the profile
profile_compare.loading: Computing the differences between the two transforms…

error.argyll_missing: ArgyllCMS (xicclu) not found: the comparison cannot be computed.
error.altered_build: One of the versions is altered: comparison impossible.
error.network: The local server does not answer.

profile_compare.identical_files: The two ICC files are identical.
profile_compare.focus_localized: Reading {{label}} (excluded in {{side}}) mainly changes its region: ΔE00 {{at}} at the patch, up to {{nearMax}} over {{nearN}} neighbouring points; elsewhere p95 {{farP95}}, max {{farMax}}.
profile_compare.focus_diffuse: Reading {{label}} (excluded in {{side}}): ΔE00 {{at}} at the patch; its {{nearN}} neighbours change up to {{nearMax}}, the rest up to {{farMax}} (p95 {{farP95}}): not a concentrated effect.
profile_compare.no_perceptual: Perceptual intent not compared: missing from one of the profiles.
profile_compare.swatch_note: Approximate preview of the RGB values sent
profile_compare.limits: Differences between two ICC transforms, computed offline (ArgyllCMS xicclu) on the measured patches ({{measured}}) and a {{grid}}³ control grid. This is not a new measurement: the comparison does not say which profile prints better. No profile is installed or rebuilt.
profile_compare.perceptual_same_both: In both profiles, the perceptual table (A2B0) is byte-identical to the colorimetric table (A2B1): the perceptual rows therefore repeat the relative ones.
profile_compare.perceptual_same_one: In profile {{side}}, the perceptual table (A2B0) is byte-identical to the colorimetric table (A2B1); the other profile has its own perceptual table.
